notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.02.03
notes.content:
This patch includes a small assortment of new features and improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773287/704638d78e94710a9c5185f7bd329a40a9ca4ce3.png[/img]

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a new small room in the [i]Celestial Observatory[/i] to introduce breakable rocks earlier, though you won't be able to break them until you return with the Boost ability.
[list]
[*] Added a new hat accessory to collect in this room.
[/list]
[*] Added a new tutorial in the first room of the [i]Overgrown Bastion[/i] to illustrate the concept of cradling the ball for better shot control.
[list]
[*] Reduced the speed and range of the moving section in this room to make the shot upward slightly easier.
[/list]
[*] Added an option to toggle Vertical Display Support for virtual pinball cabinets.
[list]
[*] When enabled, the game camera will try to frame the action better for vertical orientation.
[*] When disabled, the game camera will try to frame the action better for horizontal orientation.
[*] When set to Auto (this is the default), the game will automatically decide which behaviour to use based on the aspect ratio of the display.
[*] This option replaces the experimental [b]--vertical-display[/b] launch option previously added in version 1.01.01.
[/list]
[*] Added an option to enable a Speedrun Timer at the top-left showing the elapsed game time.
[list]
[*] The final game time is also displayed at the end of the credits after you finish the game.
[*] Please note that this will only work on [b]new games started after this patch[/b] since the game time wasn't tracked previously!
[*] The game time is stored when you save your game so you can exit, return later, and pick up with your previous time.
[/list]
[*] Increased the duration of the Boost ability to make long shots easier.
[*] Improved camera framing in a few awkward spots.
[*] Fixed an issue where an enemy can respawn directly on top of the ball and push it out of bounds.
[*] Other miscellaneous bits of polish.
[/list]

notes.title: The New Game+ Update
notes.content:
This update adds a [b]New Game+[/b] mode to Pinball Spire, along with some tweaks to support this mode, and a few other fixes and improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773287/ae89df9f75b6375864e4043679790ffc295055f9.png[/img]

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a New Game+ mode. This allows you to start a new game and carry over all unlocked abilities, player level, XP, and collected Gems from the previous save file.
[*] New Game+ is unlocked after completing the game. If you've already completed the game the new mode will unlock when you launch the game.
[*] Collected Gems are now replaced with XP Dots which award XP on contact.
[*] Added more decorative elements to the end-game rooms.
[*] Added a bit of new geometry to the boss room.
[*] Added new effects to the final cutscene.
[*] Added a button on the main menu to [url=https://starlingoboe.bandcamp.com/album/pinball-spire-original-soundtrack]get the Pinball Spire soundtrack[/url].
[*] Added an option to disable the Focus ability completely, which should help you avoid accidental Focus use when going for the Zen-Like achievement.
[*] Fixed inconsistent behaviour on speed boosters.
[*] Fixed some physics issues with shielded enemies.
[*] Fixed hit effect on breakable rocks that require multiple hits.
[*] Fixed potential physics issue on entry to the final room.
[*] Improved SFX playback logic in cases where a whole bunch of sounds are playing at once.
[*] Minor graphical performance improvements.
[/list]

[h3]About old versions and save files:[/h3]

I've continued to provide old builds on dedicated beta branches for anyone who wants to play an old version of the game but please note that I can't guarantee save compatibility when switching to older builds. Save files will always be backwards compatible (e.g. going from 1.02.01 to 1.02.02), but I can't support going in the other direction, unfortunately. It may work in some cases but it's likely going to break in others. Just a heads-up!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.02.01
notes.content:
This is a small patch focused on improving mouse controls.

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Improved the movement of the Scouter cursor when using a mouse. The in-game cursor now follows the system cursor so it will feel much more responsive.
[*] Removed the "Mouse Sensitivity (Scouter)" setting from the Options menu since it's no longer needed.
[*] Confined the mouse cursor within the game window while playing to avoid accidental clicks outside the game. The cursor is not confined in menus.
[*] Improved the screen scrolling behaviour when using a mouse in Scouter mode.
[*] Fixed an issue introduced in 1.02.00 with sluggish zooming when using the mouse wheel.
[*] Fixed a couple of minor visual glitches.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.02.00

[/list]

notes.title: The Nudge Update
notes.content:
This update introduces a new highly-requested ability to Pinball Spire: the [b]Nudge ability[/b]!

The Nudge ability can be used to bump the ball based on the input direction. Use it to save the ball when it's falling down between the flippers, or to help steer the ball where you want it to go. The Nudge ability is not required for any of the challenges in Pinball Spire but it can still help you along your journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773287/3712d9d566a6862e4befa63c84c7bee6acd8f68f.gif[/img]

Like the other abilities, nudging consumes a small amount of mana. Unlike the other abilities it also has a limited number of uses at a given time. You can use the Nudge three times in a row. These uses recharge automatically on a quick cooldown which is displayed on the icon in the HUD.

[i]This update introduces new keyboard and gamepad controls so please double-check your bindings if you made any changes.[/i]

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Added a new Nudge ability.
[*] Added a new room to introduce the Nudge ability, just before exiting the Catacombs at the beginning of the game.
[*] When loading an existing save file the Nudge ability is automatically unlocked. When starting a new game the ability needs to be collected in the new room.
[*] The new ability is mapped to the Left Stick on gamepads and keys QWEX on keyboard.
[*] These new inputs can be customized in the Control Bindings menu.
[*] The default binding for the Scouter ability has changed for gamepad controls and moved from L3 to R3. It can be rebound to L3 in the menu if you prefer.
[*] Added a Nudge Strength setting to the Game Tuning menu.
[*] Added a mechanic to replenish some mana if the ball is stuck without enough mana for nudging.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.08
notes.content:
Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Handle cases where a controller is detected twice. This should fix some input and performance issues with PlayStation controllers and possibly the Switch Pro controller.
[*] Fixed Select and Back button mappings in menus for the Switch Pro controller. The game now uses A for Select and B for Back to follow the typical convention for Nintendo controllers.
[*] Added a feature to pause the game automatically when a controller is disconnected.
[*] Save points have been updated to refill the player's mana when the game is saved.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.07
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.0.07[/h2]
A small patch for the Solar System room.

[list]
[*] Updated the Solar System room so the red planet now orbits automatically. It can no longer be moved by the player. It was far too difficult to move the red planet in some situations so this should help reduce frustration. This may get more tweaking in the future.
[/list]

[h2]Version 1.0.06[/h2]
This patch contains bug fixes, performance improvements, and design tweaks.

[list]
[*] Fixed respawning enemies and bricks sometimes forcing the ball through the wall and out of bounds if they respawn on top of the ball. They will now wait for the ball to move out of the way before respawning (with a few special exceptions).
[*] Fixed an issue where the ball's trail colour would get stuck when switching from the Rainbow Trail to the Blue Trail.
[*] Fixed some potential issues with the mechanism that rotates the center disc in the SPIRE room.
[*] Increased the minimum rotation speed of the center disc in the SPIRE room to prevent the possibility of the ball being stuck in the space at the top.
[*] Improved performance for all rooms in the Arcane Engine area. However, the room with the multi-speed gear-and-piston is still slower than I'd like and will require more attention in a future patch.
[*] Adjusted the design for the top-center section of the multi-speed gear-and-piston room to give the player a better chance to take control of the ball here.
[/list]

[h2]Version 1.0.05[/h2]
This is a small patch with some general performance improvements. If you had performance issues before please let me know if this patch has helped at all!

This patch should improve performance everywhere in the game, but some of the large Arcane Engine rooms have additional issues that will likely continue to cause problems. I'll tackle those issues separately.

[h2]Version 1.0.04[/h2]
This first patch fixes only a handful of small issues to get things going.

[list]
[*] Fixed two spots where the ball could get stuck in the "SPIRE" room in the Overgrown Bastion.
[*] Fixed a spot where the ball could get stuck in the entrance to the Overgrown Bastion (the room below the "BALL" room).
[*] Adjusted the left wall in the connecting passage above the "BALL" room in the Overgrown Bastion. The ball should now land reliably on the flipper when coming up from the spring in the room below.
[*] Added shot assist in the Solar System room for the shot up towards the exit. This will especially help players going for the Zen-Like achievement.
[*] Added a lip at the top of the Solar System room to help with some awkward shots (if one of the planets is directly above the sun). This will likely require more tweaking.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Solar System room where boosting into one of enemies orbiting a planet would sometimes send the planet spinning like crazy. :)
[*] Adjusted one of the enemies in the room at the bottom of the spire (the room with the giant crystal) to fly closer to the center. This will provide a reliable source of mana in case the ball is bouncing in place on the spring.
[/list]

notes.title: Explore the mysterious Pinball Spire!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has followed the development of Pinball Spire! Everyone who played the demo, wishlisted the game, left feedback or comments on the forum, created content about the game... thank you, we really appreciate your support! We're excited for you to embark on your journey through the Pinball Spire!

[hr][/hr] 
[previewyoutube=o4eVLrlq634;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]✨ Explore a mysterious spire[/h3]
Join our little hero Pip on an exciting journey to uncover the secrets of the Pinball Spire in an experience that combines the thrill of pinball with classic action-adventure! Use flippers, plungers, curious contraptions, and special abilities to climb to the top!

[h3]⏳ Progress at your own pace[/h3]
Activate the [i]Focus[/i] ability to slow down the action and get a preview of the ball's trajectory on a flipper, or freeze time completely with the [i]Scouter[/i] ability to survey your surroundings and inspect key objects.

[h3]🎀 Customize your Pip[/h3]
Discover fun cosmetic accessories throughout the spire to customize Pip's appearance and trail effect. Mix and match accessories to create your own style!

[hr][/hr] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601940/Pinball_Spire/

[h3]🎉 Celebrate & save during launch[/h3]
To celebrate the game's launch, Pinball Spire will be [b]10% off until October 12th[/b]! Now is the perfect time to set out on your adventure!

[h3]💕 How you can help us[/h3]
As a tiny indie team (just a solo developer plus a composer!), there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.
[list]
[*] If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.
[*] Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
[*] Follow us on [url=https://x.com/PinballSpire]Twitter[/url] to share in the excitement and get to know other great gamers.
[/list]
Good luck on your adventure!
- [i]Apparition Games[/i]
